purpose: Classify remaining independent address proof gaps from one complete passing comparison per requested function. Does not change masks, target statuses, function coverage, or whole-file equality.

build_variant.role: Committed d6186be archive recipe with the inferred source-unit split and unchanged native object bodies in ordinary archives. This report describes chronological mode and does not assert that another library-input mode has the same bytes.

selection_policy: Only instruction_and_known_target_match=true rows with measured equal complete extents; group by name/original_va/original_size; minimize unresolved_targets then unverified_targets; prefer measured extent over MAP span on ties. Failed prefixes and failed MAP spans are excluded.

independently_proven_literal_contents.scope: Existing PE HIGHLOW operands only, independently checked against original and rebuilt decoded instructions and uniquely bounded literal payloads. No extra bytes are normalized.
independently_proven_literal_contents.limitation: Complete content equality does not recover original source spelling, source allocation boundary, or API argument meaning. Rejected duplicate payloads, direct data loads, suffixes, and ambiguous aliases retain their existing unresolved statuses.

priorities.gap: Exact string and floating literal contents
priorities.needed: The current helpers independently prove accepted complete records. Remaining cases include duplicate full payloads, direct data loads, and literal suffixes; these need additional independent use/extent evidence and must not inherit proof from nearby accepted records.
Independently establish stricmp/itoa aliases, COMCTL32 ordinal 17 identity, and the folded one-byte RET functions. Preserve distinction between link aliases and source-level function identities.

Pin reviewed compiled-source operand provenance for guest-address biases, decrement-before-index loads, directory[-1], and loop end pointers. Candidate arithmetic alone does not identify the source symbol or prove its original counterpart.
Candidate SEH structure is already decoded for CFG reachability; independently compare enclosing levels and mapped filter/handler identities with the original tables.

priorities.gap: Already matching application and zlib observations
priorities.needed: 2303 selected call/address constraints currently use application function metadata, and 10 use zlib application observations. These constrain known targets but remain explicitly unverified identities; independent body/library or recovered-symbol evidence is required to upgrade them.
